description: The press and toggle primitives of the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5: SvButton with variants, sizes and a loading state, SvRepeatButton that fires while held, SvToggleButton with a pressed state, SvSwitchButton, SvCheckBox with an indeterminate state, SvRadioGroup with arrow-key navigation and SvRating with half stars. Every one is themed from the --sg-* tokens and works standalone or as a grid cell control.

faq.question: Do these controls share a theme with the grid?
faq.answer: Yes. They read the same --sg-* custom properties, so a theme preset applied to the page styles buttons, switches and the grid together.

faq.question: How does SvRepeatButton differ from SvButton?
faq.answer: It fires onclick repeatedly while the pointer is held down, with acceleration, which suits steppers and scroll controls; SvButton fires once per click.

faq.question: How do I set an indeterminate checkbox?
faq.answer: Pass indeterminate along with checked. The box shows the dash state and reports the next click as checked, which is the select-all parent pattern.
